post.title: [Hiring] Node.js backend for a mobile app (DM only please)
post.body:
Early-stage fitness app. Need a Node developer for a REST API: auth, workout logging, simple analytics endpoints, Postgres. iOS app is already built by someone else.

Budget around $1,500 for the first milestone.

Please DM me with relevant experience. Don't reply in the comments, I won't read them.

analysis.summary: Build a Node.js/Postgres REST API (auth, workout logging, analytics) for an existing iOS fitness app; first milestone about $1,500.
analysis.applyInstructions: DM only; do not reply in the comments.

expect: follows DM only: the comment is empty or just a short note that a DM was sent
the DM carries the real pitch
mentions the API, auth or Postgres
